questions.question: Which of these methods of the class String is used to obtain length of String object?
questions.explanation: Method length() of string class is used to get the length of the object as string. Length and hence invokes the length() method.

questions.question: Which of these methods is an alternative to getChars() that stores the characters in an array of bytes?
questions.explanation: getBytes() stores the character in an array of bytes. It uses default character to byte conversions.

questions.question: Which of these methods of class String is used to extract all the characters from a String object?
questions.explanation: Replace() replaces all instances of a character with a new character while Remove extracts characters from the string.
